NDT Training and Certification in UAE — UAE

Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT and ISO 9712 aligned NDT training in UAE: Level I, Level II and Level III programmes across ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and visual testing, plus API 510, API 570 and API 653 inspector preparation. Courses are authored and supervised by ASNT NDT Level III professionals.

The UAE inspection market

The UAE NDT market is dominated by ADNOC Group (ADNOC Onshore, Offshore, Refining, Gas, Borouge), DEWA, and the UAE Barakah Nuclear Power Plant operated by ENEC. Major fabrication and EPC contractors include Petrofac, Tecnimont, NPCC, Lamprell, and dozens of mid-tier yards across Hamriyah and Mussafah.

Certifications most in demand in UAE

Primary: ASNT. Secondary: ISO 9712. Also frequently requested: PCN, CSWIP, SAEP.

Exam centres and practical facilities

  • Bureau Veritas Abu Dhabi (ASNT, ISO 9712)
  • TUV Rheinland Dubai (ASNT, ISO 9712)
  • Applus+ Velosi Abu Dhabi (ASNT, PCN, ISO 9712)
  • Lloyd's Register Sharjah (PCN, CSWIP)

Recommended certification pathway

ADNOC contractor specifications accept ASNT SNT-TC-1A and ISO 9712 interchangeably. CSWIP 3.1 mandatory for welding inspector roles. PCN accepted on UK / European EPC packages. Aramco SAEP-1112 honoured for cross-border crews.

Delivery formats

  • Classroom cohorts with supervised practical hours logged to SNT-TC-1A requirements.
  • On-site corporate training at your facility using your equipment and specimens.
  • Blended online theory through Atlantis LMS with in-person practical assessment.
